specs.title: Specifications
specs.hint: Organise specs into named sections (e.g. “Display”, “Processor & memory”). Each section holds Name / Value rows. Rows left outside any section show at the top.

specs.deleteSectionConfirm_other: Delete this section and its {{count}} specifications?

customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.hint: Free-form attributes returned by the storefront API. Set Global to Yes to make the key appear on every product in the project — each product still has its own value.
customFields.rowTitle: Right-click for actions · hold 0.3s to drag
customFields.deleteGlobalConfirm:
Delete global field "{{key}}"?
It will be removed from EVERY product in this project.

service.linking: Linking this product to a booking service…
service.title: Service details
service.hint: How customers book this service — duration, price, image, staff. Editing here mirrors Bookings → Services.
service.visibleHint: Hidden services don't appear in the storefront.
service.requiresStaffHintOn: When ON, customers must pick a specific staff member (each slot = one person at a time).
service.requiresStaffHintOff: When OFF, slots use the capacity below — useful for group classes / shared resources.
service.capacityHint: How many simultaneous bookings fit into one slot (1 = exclusive).
service.staffLabel: Staff that can deliver this service
service.staffHintRequired: Customers will pick one of these.

preview.title: Preview & pricing
preview.hint: Showcase media shown on the storefront and the price buyers pay. The first item is the cover image.
preview.mediaHint: Photo, video or 3D model — the first one becomes the cover.
preview.priceHint: What the customer pays for the download.
preview.zip: Deliver all files as a single ZIP archive
preview.zipHint: When off, the customer downloads each file separately.

digital.title: Files
digital.hint: Files customers receive after purchase. URLs are signed and emailed automatically when the order is paid.
digital.empty: No files yet. Add the digital product (PDF, image, archive…) below.
digital.dropHint: PDF, image, video, archive — any type, multiple at once

modifiers.title: Modifiers
modifiers.hint: Group add-ons by category. Each group is either Checkbox (multi-select) or Radio (single-select), with optional min / max selection and required flag. Drag items between groups, drag whole groups to reorder.
modifiers.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete this group and all its items?
modifiers.noItems: No items yet — add one below.

seo.title: SEO
seo.hint: Used by the storefront for search-engine results.
seo.seoDescriptionPlaceholder: Brief page description for search results…

apiPreview.title: API Preview
apiPreview.singleHint: What your storefront receives when it calls
apiPreview.listHintPre: What your storefront receives when it calls
apiPreview.listHintPost: . Each item carries the exact same payload as the single-product endpoint. The example below wraps this product in a 1-element array — the real response contains every product in the catalog.

history.title: Edit history
history.stockHintPre: Immutable audit log of every change to per-SKU stock. Most recent first. Last 100 events. Stock itself is edited from
history.waitlistHint: Customers who clicked "Notify me" while this product was out of stock. They get an email automatically once a restock is recorded.

perSku.title: Per-SKU details
perSku.hintEmpty: Add at least one Layer-2 configuration on the product Overview page to start editing per-SKU details (barcode, weight, dimensions, per-SKU pricing).
perSku.hint: Each leaf configuration has its own SKU code, barcode, weight, dimensions and pricing options. Pick one below to edit.
perSku.barcodeHint: EAN-13 / UPC printed on this specific SKU
perSku.compareAtPriceHint: Strike-through original price when on sale
perSku.salePriceHint: Active price during the sale window

catalog.title: Catalog identification
catalog.hint: Inventory codes, brand info, customs / origin. Used by accountants, warehouse staff, and regulatory exports (HS code, country of origin).
catalog.manufacturerHint: Who actually makes it (may differ from brand)
catalog.vendorHint: Who you buy it from (internal use)
catalog.taxCategoryHint: Configure list in Project Settings → Tax categories

shipping.title: Shipping & fulfillment
shipping.hint: Controls used by carrier-API rate calculation and checkout shipping options.
shipping.shippingClassHint: Carrier API uses this for surcharges

inventory.title: Inventory behaviour
inventory.hint: Stock-out behaviour and alert thresholds. Per-SKU stock is edited on the Overview / Inventory pages.
inventory.continueSelling: Continue selling when out of stock
inventory.continueSellingHint: Backorder mode — checkout never blocks on stock=0
inventory.lowStockHint: Alert when total stock drops to this level (0 = off)
inventory.preOrderHint: Listed but not yet released — uses release date below

b2b.title: B2B / Wholesale
b2b.hint: Minimum quantity, increments, and B2B payment options. Tier pricing ladders are configured in Products → Tier pricing.
b2b.moqHint: Cart blocks orders smaller than this
b2b.orderIncrementHint: Quantity must be MOQ + N × increment (e.g. dozen-pack)
b2b.allowPoHint: Customer can pay via PO# instead of card

social.title: Social preview
social.hint: URL of the image used by Facebook / Twitter / Telegram link previews (Open Graph tags). Falls back to the first variation cover if empty.
social.ogImageHint: HTTPS URL to a 1200×630 image (Facebook/Twitter recommended)

gallery.addMediaHint: Add image, video, or 3D / AR file. Upload from your computer or paste a YouTube / Vimeo URL.
gallery.allowed: Allowed: images (jpg/png/webp/gif), video (mp4/webm/mov), 3D / AR (glb/usdz/gltf). External URLs must be from YouTube or Vimeo over https.
